Two low-load rotations, `alerts` (alice, bob, carol, dave) and `tickets` (carol, dave, alice, bob), with a `joined` link from the start. Without the link each rotation would follow its own roster order and different people would hold the two roles in the same week. With it, `alerts` is decided first and `tickets` prefers the member already holding the overlapping `alerts` shift whenever that member is inside the tolerance band, which with equal scores is always, so `tickets` runs in lockstep with `alerts`: alice, bob, carol, dave in both. The snapshots therefore show the same scores per member in both rotations (alice 28, bob 28, carol 21, dave 21) and the generated weeks after 09-07 pair up carol/carol, dave/dave, alice/alice, bob/bob. `expected/status.txt` shows the pairs in the `#All shifts` view.
